component.name: PoE Recorder
component.summary: Automatically record and review Path of Exile map runs

description.p: PoE Recorder records each Path of Exile 2 map run from the game's Client.txt log and keeps a local library of videos with the map, area level, deaths and trips out of the map.
A native Linux and Wayland application based on Warcraft Recorder. Recordings and configuration remain local.

screenshot.caption: Recording library and player with a timeline.

description.p: First release of PoE Recorder. Path of Exile 2 map runs are recorded automatically from the game's Client.txt, with portal trips kept in one video, death markers, and the hideout time after the run cut off. The World of Warcraft support of Warcraft Recorder, which this is based on, is removed.
